title: Sharper click attacks
changes: Clicking a monster now walks you right into sword reach, so melee swings no longer whiff at the edge.
Your hero aims at where the monster really is, not where it was a moment ago (no more swinging at a spot it was knocked away from).
Big monsters like the Mother Blob, Bone Demon and Redfang Chief can be hit on their edge, not only in their middle.
A click during your attack cooldown now waits and swings as soon as it can, instead of doing nothing.
